title: Before and After Puzzle
summary: Given a list of phrases, generate a list of Before and After puzzles by merging each pair of phrases where the last word of the first phrase matches the first word of the second phrase.
statement: Given a list of phrases, generate a list of Before and After puzzles by merging each pair of phrases where the last word of the first phrase matches the first word of the second phrase. The merged phrases should be distinct, sorted lexicographically, and both orders of merging should be considered.
constraints: Return distinct merged phrases in lexicographic order.
hints: Compare the last word of each possible left phrase with the first word of each different right phrase.
When they match, append the right phrase without repeating its first word.
Use a set to remove duplicate merged strings.
Sorting that set produces the required deterministic result after considering both directions.
editorial: Sorting that set produces the required deterministic result after considering both directions.

tests.explanation: The shared word code joins the phrases into writing code rocks.

expected: a chip off the old block party
